campbell.title: Campbell City Council — July 7, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered a new interim ordinance related to state Senate legislation, along with public hearings on revoking the business license and tobacco retailer permits for two local shops, California Cigar and Hayes Smoke Shop. The council also considered authorizing a grant application for public works funding and approving consultant service agreements.
keyTopics: Interim ordinance implementing state Senate legislation, replacing a prior interim ordinance
Revocation of business license and tobacco retailer permit for California Cigar
Revocation of business license and tobacco retailer permit for Hayes Smoke Shop
Authorization for the Public Works Director to submit a One Bay Area Grant application
Approval of consultant service agreements

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — June 3, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council considered the service level options the Santa Clara County Sheriff's Office proposed for the upcoming fiscal year (2026-27), and was asked to direct staff on which option to pursue. A follow-up item asked the Council for further direction once it identified its near-term approach to Sheriff services.
keyTopics: Sheriff's Office proposed service level options for FY 2026-27
Direction to staff on which policing service level to pursue
Follow-up direction once the Council settles on its near-term Sheriff approach

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — August 18, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council considered routine business including meeting minutes, financial reports, and payment registers, along with a professional services agreement and a second amendment to an existing contract. The Council also took up appointing a voting delegate for a statewide city conference, an ordinance making minor housekeeping updates to the Town Code, and a request about whether to continue or hear a public hearing on one or more appeals.
keyTopics: Professional services agreement authorization
June 2026 monthly financial and investment report
Voting delegate appointment for League of California Cities Annual Conference
Omnibus ordinance making minor Town Code updates
Second amendment to an existing agreement
Decision on continuing or hearing a public hearing appeal

san-jose.title: San José Community & Economic Development Committee (CED) — August 24, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Community & Economic Development Committee (CED) considered an audit report reviewing how well the City Manager's Office of Economic Development and Cultural Affairs is tracking and measuring its performance. The committee also considered a semi-annual status update on the city's ongoing economic development activities and initiatives.
keyTopics: Audit of performance measures used by the Office of Economic Development and Cultural Affairs
Review of how the department tracks progress toward its goals
Semi-annual update on citywide economic development activities
Status of ongoing economic development programs and projects

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee — August 17, 2026
mountain-view.summary: Mountain View's Youth Advisory Committee met to hear public comments and discuss the upcoming Summer Movie Nights event. The committee also reviewed its own role and purpose and held elections for leadership positions, followed by member and staff updates on other city boards and committees.
keyTopics: Public comments from residents
Planning for Summer Movie Nights
Discussion of the Youth Advisory Committee's role and responsibilities
Election of committee leadership positions
Updates from other city boards, commissions, and committees

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — August 24, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: This was a public scoping meeting on August 24, 2026, to gather community input on the environmental review (EIR) for the proposed 1250 Oakmead Parkway residential project. Members of the City Council, Heritage Preservation Commission, and Planning Commission could attend, since a quorum of each body was possible, but no formal decisions were made at this session. Language translation services were available for residents who requested them.
keyTopics: Environmental Impact Report (EIR) scoping for the 1250 Oakmead Parkway residential project
Public input gathering on potential environmental impacts of the proposed development
Joint attendance by City Council, Heritage Preservation Commission, and Planning Commission members
Availability of language translation services for attendees

cupertino.title: Cupertino Teen Commission — August 12, 2026
cupertino.summary: Cupertino's Teen Commission met to plan the upcoming Bike Fest event and discuss a Juvenile Traffic Diversion Program. They also heard about a youth-led group called Next Vision AI and reviewed minutes from their June 10 meeting.
keyTopics: Planning for the Bike Fest event
Juvenile Traffic Diversion Program discussion
Presentation on youth-led group Next Vision AI
Approval of June 10, 2026 meeting minutes

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — August 18, 2026
santa-clara.summary: This Santa Clara City Council meeting was held in a hybrid format, allowing Council/Boardmember Chahal to participate remotely from India while other members and the public could attend in person or join via Zoom or phone. The agenda posting mainly covered logistical details for public participation rather than listing specific policy items.
keyTopics: Remote participation by Council/Boardmember Chahal from Panchkula, India
Hybrid meeting format combining in-person attendance with Zoom and phone access
Instructions for submitting written public comment before the meeting via eComm

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — August 11, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council considered introducing an ordinance to amend part of the city's municipal code and received an educational presentation on how municipal bonds work. The meeting also covered routine business, including approval of past meeting minutes, the upcoming council meeting calendar, and a preview of items planned for the next regular meeting.
keyTopics: Proposed ordinance amending Municipal Code Title XIII, Chapter B.6
"Municipal Bonds 101" presentation from the Finance Department
Review of the City Council's upcoming meeting calendar
Approval of prior City Council meeting minutes
Councilmembers' requests for future agenda items

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Public Art Commission — August 20, 2026
palo-alto.summary: Palo Alto's Public Art Commission considered public art plans as part of the 3150 El Camino Real private development, with a presentation from the project's art consultant, artist, and development team. Members also considered funding for temporary interactive media art installations and the acceptance of donated artworks from two local artists into the city's public art collection.
keyTopics: Final review and approval of public art plan for the 3150 El Camino Real development
Presentation by artist Giles Miller and Acclaim Companies development team
Up to $70,000 in funding for Code:ART 2027 temporary interactive media installations
Acceptance of donated artworks by CASP artists Adrienne Defendi and Eric Fei Guan
Approval of June 18, 2026 meeting minutes
